findings.evidence: Text inputs are labeled only by placeholder (e.g. <input name="phone" placeholder="Phone">). Automated label checks PASS these because the placeholder feeds accessible-name computation; the hint still disappears on entry and is not a label. Verified by inspection of before-form.tsx.
findings.recommendation: Add visible <label> elements associated via htmlFor/id; keep hints in aria-describedby.

findings.evidence: Service cards are <div onClick> with no role, tabindex, or keydown handler (before-service-cards.tsx). Reproduction: Tab through the page; the six cards are never focusable and cannot be activated by keyboard.
findings.recommendation: Make the affordance a real link or button.

findings.evidence: before.css sets outline: none on every focused element in the variant with no replacement. Reproduction: Tab through any /before page; no focus indicator ever appears.
findings.recommendation: Provide a visible high-contrast focus indicator; never remove outlines without a replacement.

findings.evidence: Third provider image carries alt="IMG_4821.JPG". Automated checks pass it (alt is present); a screen reader reads a camera filename.
findings.recommendation: Describe meaningful images or mark decorative ones with empty alt.

findings.evidence: Playwright verification 2026-07-26: with focus inside the newsletter popup, a dispatched Tab keydown has defaultPrevented=true (swallowed); Escape leaves the dialog open; the only close control is a <span onClick> (mouse-only). Keyboard users cannot leave the dialog.
findings.recommendation: Contain focus properly (wrap, not swallow), close on Escape, make the close control a real button, restore focus on close.

findings.evidence: Carousel auto-advances on an infinite CSS animation with !important that overrides the global prefers-reduced-motion kill switch (before.css); there is no pause/stop/hide control.
findings.recommendation: Provide pause/stop/hide; honor prefers-reduced-motion; avoid autoplay.

findings.evidence: Submitting the empty form turns invalid field borders red (border-[#dc2626]) with no error text, no aria-invalid, no focus move, and no announcement (before-form.tsx onSubmit). Screen reader output: silence.
findings.recommendation: Identify errors in text, associate them to fields, and announce them (error summary + aria-describedby).

findings.evidence: The before-header is position:sticky top-0 and no scroll-padding/scroll-margin exists anywhere in the scope. Reproduction: Shift+Tab upward through the locations page; focused links scroll underneath the header and become invisible while focused.
findings.recommendation: Reserve the header height with scroll-padding-top, or un-stick the header.

findings.evidence: The form re-asks for the name and phone number entered moments earlier (visible pseudo-labels: Confirm your name, Re-enter phone), with no autofill or carry-over.
findings.recommendation: Ask once; auto-populate or drop confirmation fields.
